--- Redwood technical response (draft) ---
Summary (what we commit in the RFP):
- Standard export formats: NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) and Parquet (columnar), compressed as .gz or .zip. We will also provide a manifest.csv listing file checksums and schema versions.
- Schema versioning: every export includes a schema_version field and a manifest mapping objects to schema versions. We support stable schemas (v1, v2) and provide a change log. Exports are backwards-readable for any schema version within a 36-month retention compatibility window.
- Reconstructability: exports include event sequence numbers, RFC3339 timestamps (UTC), and optional full KV-cache snapshots for sessions where reconstructability is requested. We can produce contiguous segments (time-range or sequence-range) to aid replay.
- Redaction options:
  * PII redaction: deterministic redaction using salted hashing (HMAC-SHA256) with customer-provided salt or per-export salt preserved in the manifest (if customer requests). Redaction is irreversible unless a reversible pseudonymization mode is contracted.
  * Pseudonymization: reversible tokenization available as a premium option; keys are stored in a customer-managed KMS and can be exported under a legally agreed process.
- Tamper-evidence and chain-of-custody:
  * Each export includes SHA-256 checksums for each file and a signed export manifest.
  * For contract-level tamper-evidence we offer optional manifest signing using an HSM-backed key (RSASSA-PSS) and timestamping via RFC3161/TSA (additional fee may apply).
  * Our standard process captures export auditentries (who requested, job id, time, destination), retained in the control plane audit trail for 24 months by default (configurable).
- Delivery and SLAs:
  * Standard bulk export: delivery within 5 business days for exports <= 250GB (S3 share or secure FTP).
  * Large exports (>250GB) or multi-archive deliveries: 10 business days with staged delivery option.
  * Expedited legal-hold pull: 24-48 hours for scoped, accelerated snapshots (subject to support/ops availability and a validated request).
  * We will commit these windows in the SOW with an SLA credit structure for missed delivery windows (details in commercial).
- Export mechanics and security controls:
  * Output is encrypted in transit (TLS1.3) and at rest (AES-256). For S3 delivery we support customer-owned KMS keys.
  * Delivery options: pre-signed S3 URLs to a customer bucket, SFTP push to customer endpoint, or temporary AWS account access (per mutual agreement).
  * We support multipart/parallel upload and deliver a manifest.csv with checksums (SHA256), byte ranges and schema_version tags.
- Legal hold & preservation notes:
  * Exports requested under legal hold will be flagged and preserved; we offer a preservation SLA and isolated snapshot storage for the hold duration.
  * Preservation requests can be retained beyond customer's active retention window under a paid add-on.
- Fees and operational notes:
  * Standard export is included once per contract year for up to 250GB. Additional exports, expedited pulls, HSM signing, or pseudonymization are billable. Exact pricing is in the SOW.

Operational caveats / clarifications:
- Redaction: deterministic hashing requires custody of the salt; if Redwood holds the salt, the redaction can be reversed only per a documented legal process.
- Compatibility: parquet exports preserve typed fields; NDJSON is recommended for ingestion into e-discovery tools.
- Evidence chain: we provide an export manifest, checksums, and an operations audit record; customers may elect to have us include a notarization/timestamp service as an add-on.

Attachments included for RFP: audit_export_schema_v1.json (sample schema), chain_of_custody_template.docx (sample manifest and chain-of-custody checklist).
